prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your case details and priorities (severity of injuries, fault dispute, desire to go to trial, budget). I can help find good fits — but first, a few quick questions:

- Where in Atlanta (ZIP or neighborhood) did the crash occur and where do you live?
- How serious are the injuries and are you still being treated?
- Is fault clear or disputed? Are there police reports or witnesses?
- Do you already have an insurer handling a claim?
- Do you prefer a large firm or a smaller boutique lawyer?

If you want to start on your own, here’s how to identify the best personal injury lawyer for a car accident in Atlanta and what to ask at a consultation:

What to look for
- Substantial experience with Georgia car-accident/catastrophic-injury cases (not just a general practice).
- Trial experience and a record of settlements and verdicts — you want someone who will take a case to trial if necessary.
- Track record of outcomes and case value ranges similar to yours.
- Clear contingency-fee terms (most work on contingency — “no win, no fee” except costs).
- Good client communication and responsiveness.
- Positive client reviews and peer recognitions (Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell).
- Clean disciplinary record (check the Georgia State Bar).

Where to search and verify
- Georgia State Bar Lawyer Directory and Lawyer Referral Service.
- Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo (client reviews and ratings).
- Local bar association referrals (Atlanta Bar Association).
- Google/Better Business Bureau for reviews and complaints.

Key questions to ask in the free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many in Atlanta/Georgia?
- What percentage of your practice is personal injury?
- Have you handled cases like mine (injuries, fault issues)?
- What are typical outcomes and settlement ranges in such cases?
- Do you try cases? Can you give examples of verdicts or settlements?
- What is your fee structure and who pays case costs if we don’t win?
- Who in the firm will handle the day‑to‑day work?
- How will you communicate updates and how often?

Next step
If you share your ZIP code and a couple of case details (injuries, insurance status, fault), I can pull together a short list of Atlanta personal injury lawyers/firms, summarize their experience and reviews, and suggest 3–5 to call for consultations. Which ZIP and a brief description of your case?
